desc: Parse input: read N, M, start point, N house coordinates, and M (direction, length) actions from stdin.
Build two dictionaries: `by_x[x] = sorted list of (y, idx)` and `by_y[y] = sorted list of (x, idx)`, from the house list.
Simulate the M moves: update current position per direction; for each segment determine its fixed coordinate and the inclusive [lo, hi] range of the varying coordinate.
For each segment, use bisect on the matching dictionary list to find houses in range, and insert their indices into a visited set to count distinct houses.
Handle edge cases: normalize ranges with min/max, inclusive endpoints, Python ints avoid overflow.
Output final X, Y, and the size of the visited set, space-separated, using fast I/O.

Implement the full solution: parse input with sys.stdin.buffer, build by_x/by_y dicts of sorted (coord, idx) lists, simulate M moves using bisect to collect house indices into a visited set, then output final X, Y, and len(visited).
